name: What is an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU)?

mainEntity.name: What is an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU)?

acceptedAnswer.text: An Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) is a secondary housing unit on a single-family residential lot. It can be an attached or detached structure, such as a backyard cottage, a converted garage, or a basement apartment. ADUs provide homeowners with options for additional living space, which can serve various needs from housing family members to generating rental income.
acceptedAnswer.description: An ADU is a secondary housing unit on a single-family residential lot, providing additional living space.
